alt: Three Apple HomePod mini 2 speakers in green, pink, and blue mesh fabric arranged in a product photograph — Apple's new smart speaker whose flagship Siri AI feature will be absent when it goes on sale October 30, 2026
story: Apple announced the HomePod mini 2 at $149 on October 13, 2026, marketing it with 'Siri AI' as the headline upgrade — but the product page footnote reads 'available later in a future software update,' meaning the speaker's entire selling point won't exist when it goes on sale October 30.
why_funny: Apple named and marketed a product after its AI assistant, put that on the product page, then quietly added a footnote explaining the AI assistant won't actually be in the product at launch.
